title: Scene gallery — real-table, shipped 600
description: The 600 build sheets delivered to hardware, 100 per tier per horizon. Tiered from the original search sweep. Kept as shipped; the full exhaustive pool is the other card.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, full exhaustive pool
description: Every exhaustively labelled real-table scene, both horizons, ONE movable block each. The two-movable rooms are the other card, and nothing here has a second block to interact with. Tiers come from pure depth-2 enumeration (every first push ends in a finish or a proven dead end), not from the search sweep, so the solve rates differ from the shipped 600. Counts are not written here on purpose; the live line above is read from the index.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, two movable blocks
description: Two-movable real-table doorways, filtered to the ones where a solving push also shoves the second block. Labels are computed at the 1 mm inflation margin the robot runs; every card carries inflation_margin_m and a status. A card tiered `dead` is a room that stopped being a region-opening problem at that margin, either because the robot already reaches the goal or because the goal is no longer a separate region; it keeps its card so it can be inspected, and has no greens. Difficulty is per horizon: 1push scores openers over enumerated pushes, 2push scores openers plus setups, both against the 5%/30% cuts. Cards say when the doorway needs both blocks and whether a route around exists. ⛔ Step-through replays were recorded against the older 5 mm labels and have NOT been rebuilt, so a card's animation may show a push that is no longer green; `replay_margin_m` records this.
